description:
Search 35 additional tools that are loaded on demand. Send one keyword query per capability you need; returns matching tool names and descriptions. Then `tool_describe` loads schemas and `tool_call` invokes. Tools already in your tool list need no search. Searches also cover the user's connected app accounts, whose tools are hosted and so never listed here (results named `connectors__<app>__<tool>`); `manage_connections` checks or connects an account and installs MCP servers.

Every tool listed below exists: never call it unavailable, and go straight to `tool_describe` when you see the exact name.

Deferred tool catalog (call schemas via `tool_describe`, invoke via `tool_call`):
- browser_vault: Fill saved logins, 2FA codes, cards and addresses on the CURRENT browser page.
- browser_exec: Drive a real browser for JS pages, logins, forms and clicks (Browser Use CLI).
- computer_use: Drive the desktop via cua-driver: screenshots, mouse, keyboard, scroll, drag.
- manage_connections: Connect the user's app accounts and install MCP servers.
- cronjob_manage: Schedule recurring or one-off agent tasks (cron jobs): create, list, edit, run.
- dashboard: Read and arrange this session dashboard.
- decision_evaluate: Evaluate ONLY the supplied state with a separately configured decision model.
- gateway: Gateway self-management (owner only).
- image_generate: Generate or edit images (with reference images) using the configured model.
- mobile_ui: Control a paired Android app with Accessibility Control enabled (owner only).
- nodes: Discover, configure, and control paired devices (owner only).
- plugins: Plugin lifecycle over the Hermes plugin system (owner only).
- portal: Allocate loopback portal routes for local dev servers (open/list/close).
- presence: List live people, devices and recent activity on this gateway.
- providers: Manage Hermes model providers.
- session_search: Search or read past Hermes conversations (FTS5), or scroll inside one.
- process_manage: Poll, wait on, send input to, or kill terminal(background=true) processes.
- transcripts: List, read, transcribe, or store meeting and voice transcripts.
- text_to_speech: Convert text to speech audio.
- vision_analyze: Load an image into the conversation so you can see it.
browser-cdp tools (2):
- browser_cdp: Send a raw Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP) command.
- browser_dialog: Accept or dismiss a native JS dialog (alert/confirm/prompt) blocking the page.
conversations tools (5):
- conversations_list: List the Telegram conversations this bot account can message.
- conversations_turn: Send one message to a Telegram conversation by its conv_ ref.
- dismiss_task: Remove a pending suggestion created by suggest_task.
- sessions_send: Send a message to an existing session by its session id or subagent run id.
- suggest_task: Suggest a follow-up task for the owner to approve.
github tools (2):
- github_identity_status: Inspect the effective GitHub account and credential health.
- github_publish: Publish a session workspace as a draft GitHub PR.
sessions tools (4):
- agents_list: List the agents in this run: the current agent and its live subagents.
- session_status: Read this session's status: model, usage, label, state, activity.
- sessions: Read, organise, delete, or group Hermes sessions.
- sessions_list: List Hermes sessions from the session registry, newest first.
turn_control tools (2):
- agents_wait: Wait for subagent runs to settle and collect their results, without polling.
- sessions_yield: End this turn to await pending child completions, not submit a final result.
name: tool_search

queries.description: One query per capability: service + action + object keywords (e.g. ['gmail send email', 'github create issue']), never a question; every word must match tool text. Searched in parallel.
